headline: Dončić's 52 Buries Zero Fox Given 9-2
subhead: Week 1 is final: Acinonyx closed out Zero Fox Given 9-2, LeParth James survived Thug Life 6-5, and MONSTARS ☄️ and Suggs to be you split 5-5-1.

zingers.line: Zero Fox Given sent two players out on the final day, has made zero moves all season, and lost 9-2.
Thug Life won Sunday 9-2 and still lost the week 6-5, because Jalen Brunson needed 28 shots to make 12.
LeParth James got three players on the floor Sunday, lost the night 9-2, and backed into a 6-5 week.
Scottie Barnes went 0 for 12 Sunday, and MONSTARS ☄️ had to settle for a 5-5-1 tie.
Nova Knicks posted the worst Sunday in the league, Jakob Poeltl scored 0, and they still won the week 7-4.
White Mambas won Sunday 6-4-1 and still lost the week 7-4, with Keyonte George coughing up 6 turnovers.
theInfamous lost the week 8-3 to Adam Silver Dez Nuts, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's 34 on Sunday rubbed it in.

night: Luka Dončić posted 52 points, 10 assists and 8 threes for Acinonyx, the best line of the night, sealing a 9-2 week over Zero Fox Given.
Scottie Barnes shot 0 for 12 and 0 for 5 from three for MONSTARS ☄️, the worst brick of the night, in a week that ended 5-5-1 with Suggs to be you.
Ja'Kobe Walter dropped 22 points and 5 threes on 7 for 12 shooting and is still sitting on the wire.
Thug Life took the final night 9-2 off LeParth James, who got three players on the floor, and still lost the week 6-5.
Nova Knicks posted the worst night in the league and still closed out White Mambas 7-4 for the week.
